name: week
title: This week's forecast
subtitle: Open periods. What moved, what is at risk, what needs a decision.

sections.title: Forecast by rep
sections.sql: select f.period, f.rep, f.currency, f.quota_cents, f.won_cents, f.commit_cents, f.best_case_cents, f.call_commit_cents as rep_call_cents, f.gap_cents from v_forecast f join periods p on p.id = f.period_id where p.status = 'open' and current_date between p.starts and p.ends and (f.quota_cents > 0 or f.open_deals > 0) order by f.rep

sections.title: What moved in the last seven days
sections.note: Compared with the last snapshot taken at least a week ago.
sections.sql: select period, change, deal, rep, currency, from_amount_cents as was_cents, to_amount_cents as now_cents, delta_cents as change_cents, detail from v_movement order by period

sections.title: Deals at risk
sections.sql: select deal, rep, forecast_category as category, currency, amount_cents, close_date, string_agg(risk || ' (' || detail || ')', '; ') as risks from v_deal_risk group by deal, rep, forecast_category, currency, amount_cents, close_date order by amount_cents desc

sections.title: Overdue follow-ups
sections.sql: select f.due, f.owner, f.note, o.name as deal from followups f left join opportunities o on o.id = f.opportunity_id where f.resolved_at is null and f.due < current_date order by f.due

name: slippage
title: Slipped deals
subtitle: Every open deal whose close date has moved out, with the first date it was given.

sections.title: Slipped deals
sections.sql: select d.deal, d.rep, d.forecast_category as category, d.currency, d.amount_cents, (select min(old_value) from opportunity_history h where h.opportunity_id = d.id and h.field = 'close_date') as first_close, d.close_date as close_now, d.pushes from v_deals d where d.pushes > 0 and not d.is_closed order by d.pushes desc, d.amount_cents desc

name: accuracy
title: Forecast accuracy
subtitle: How close each rep's calls came to what they won, for closed periods.

sections.title: Calls against results
sections.sql: select period, rep, currency, first_call_on, first_call_cents, last_call_cents, won_cents, first_call_error_pct, last_call_error_pct from v_accuracy order by period, abs(first_call_error_pct) desc nulls last

sections.title: Findings
sections.note: Checks against the rules in docs/compliance.md. They flag records to look at. They are not legal or accounting advice.
sections.sql: select severity, rule, item, issue from v_compliance order by case severity when 'breach' then 1 else 2 end, rule
